gizmo.title: Mamiriro ane mapazi
gizmo.description: Nyaya iyo sarudzo imwe neimwe inotungamira kuchiitiko nemagumo akasiyana. Vadzidzi vanogona kudzokera shure vachiedza dzimwe nzira; magumo asvikwa anoisa mamakisi.

configure.title: Chiitiko chekutanga
configure.description: ID yechiitiko chinotangira vadzidzi. Siya pasina chinhu kuti utange pachiitiko chekutanga.

advanced.title: Ruvara rwekusimbisa
advanced.description: Ruvara rwesarudzo rwechip yemusoro, mabhatani nemucheto wesarudzo.
